## Setup checklist
1. This is a new webhook — Whizz's Discovery "deeper search" pass and the Leads "Enrich Telegram" modal both call it at POST https://n8n.aiingo.com/webhook/whizz-enrich-social-search once the website/Instagram pass (handled entirely in the Cloudflare Worker, no n8n involved) comes up empty for a lead. Import this workflow and activate it; no existing webhook to replace.
2. Open **Call Apify Google Search Actor** → Authentication is Predefined Credential Type → Apify API. Select the same Apify credential already used by whizz-discover-google-maps (or create one) — this reuses that account/billing, no new API key needed.
3. Actor ID in **Build Apify Request** is `apify~google-search-scraper` (apify.com/apify/google-search-scraper) — a long-standing, widely-used actor (queries as a newline-separated string, resultsPerPage/maxPagesPerQuery input). Its exact output field names are NOT verified against a live run from this codebase (apify.com is unreachable from this environment) — **Map Results to Whizz** works around that by JSON.stringifying each whole dataset item and regexing for a t.me/wa.me link rather than depending on an exact field name, but still worth a test run before relying on it — check whether it actually finds hits for a business you already know has a public WhatsApp/Telegram link somewhere on the web.
4. This is an extra Apify run per batch of leads (capped at 15/request by the Worker) on top of Google Maps discovery — it's meant to run only for leads the free website/Instagram scan already came up empty for, not as a first resort, so treat it as a paid, opt-in "go deeper" step.
5. Whizz calls this at POST https://n8n.aiingo.com/webhook/whizz-enrich-social-search with body {leads:[{key,query}]} (key is whatever id the caller wants results matched back to — a lead id or a discovery result's website/name; query is a ready-built search string like `"Acme Trading LLC" Dubai (whatsapp OR telegram)`) and expects back {"results":{"<key>":{"telegram":"handle","whatsapp":"+9715..."}}} — a key with nothing found is simply omitted, not returned empty.
